title.en: MAL AC AN ANG RESIDENCE OF THE PRESIDENT OF THE 1HILIFF INES BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIFTINES INSTITUTING THE GOLDEN HEART FRESIDENTIAL AWARD

text.en:
In the case of individual awards, the medal and
ribbon will be presented, and in the case of organizations or
entities a simple narra plaque on which the obverse and reverse
of the medal will be placed. The medal should be of bronze cilded
and of little Intrinsic volue but it should be something which
will be a valued and honcred heirlom for the recipients to hand
down to their successors.
The award will not be limited to those giving
large financial or other material contributions, as there are
smaller aida

- 2 -
smaller aids which may represent comparatively equal or even
grester sacrifices on the part of the donor,
Until the ConFress
sets aside an appropriation for this award, the same shall be
paid for from the discretionary funds of the President of the
Thilippines.
Done in the City of Manila, this 21st day of June, In the
year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-four,
Independence of the Philippines, the eighth.
(SGD.) RAMMON MAGSAYSAY
President of the Fhilippines
By the President:
(SGD.) FRED RUIZ CASTRO
Executive Secretary
